content.rationale: Ownership is where S2-own's one attribution path, S2-own-inline's degenerate case, and D2's exact rule meet; this check pins the owned set for array and inline documents. It reads the loaded document as serde_json, so it is a crate of its own. I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the crate is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive.
